# REAL headlines captured from live feeds on 2026-08-13 during a 100-second
# dry-run. Every one of these reached Stage 2 as a CANDIDATE, and NONE of them
# reports Donald Trump's death.
#
# This corpus is worth more than any synthetic test in this repo, because these
# are the actual adversaries the system faces on an ordinary news day.
#
# The hard safety invariant tests/test_live_negatives.py enforces:
#   NO item here may score >= fire_policy.min_score (0.80).
# That threshold is what enables fast-path firing and what lets two independent
# tier-1 outlets reach CONFIRMED. A false positive at or above it is a false
# alert on your phone.
#
# The Lindsey Graham cluster is the one that mattered: it was reported by the
# Guardian (0.922), Bloomberg (0.837), Al-Monitor (0.837), NYT (0.757), Semafor
# and Le Monde. Two independent tier-1 origins above min_score = CONFIRMED.
